    WELCOME TO THE CLUB

    A small ritual.

    Choose one of the five tapes in the rack or collection. Drag the room to look around, or choose Inspect tape to turn the selected cassette in your hands.

    Press Insert cassette, then Play. Rewind and fast forward wind the tape until you pause. Eject returns the same cassette to its original slot.

    Add audio accepts multiple local files and adds them to the selected tape’s playlist. Playlists and supported local audio are saved in this browser. Clearing browser data removes them. Add song accepts YouTube links or licensed audio URLs. YouTube entries open on YouTube; the deck plays audio files. Manage lets you edit, move or remove tracks.
